notes.title: Skyward Steps Together Official Gameplay Trailer
notes.notes:
🌟 Our First Gameplay Trailer is Here! 🌟

Hey everyone!

We’re excited to share the first official gameplay trailer for Skyward Steps Together! 🎥✨ This co-op multiplayer platformer adventure will challenge you and your friends as you climb, jump, and solve puzzles to restore balance to the world.

🌀 What to Expect in the Trailer?
✅ Intense co-op platformer action – Work together to save the city!
✅ Abilities – Use unique skills to overcome obstacles.
✅ Challenging puzzles  – Every step matters!
✅ A world in chaos – Can you restore the legendary Harmony Stone?
